Follow [[Aidan]]'s markers to traverse the treacherous cave into [[Kryta]].

== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Follow Aidan's [[Mark of Aidan|marker]]s through the Ice Cave.
* See Aidan for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

== Walkthrough ==
When you accept the quest, [[Snow]] will immediately start running into the cave, pausing for a short time at each [[Mark of Aidan]]. You do not have to keep up with Snow or pick up the Marks of Aidan; your only task is to reach [[Aidan]] at the other end of the cave. Along the way, you will encounter numerous [[Snow Ettin]]s; they inflict [[Weakness]] and have a high physical damage output for their level, so consider [[pull]]ing if you run into too many at once. Two [[White Mantle]] members will also be walking the same path more slowly, so you can follow them and fight with them as long as they survive. If all else fails, simply follow the right wall of the cave.

Snow and the Marks of Aidan lead around the outer edge of the cave, where the ettin groups are more predictable but are not guaranteed to be smaller. To save time, you can instead abandon your allies and cut across the middle of the zone, taking a more direct route to get to Aidan. Regardless, when you are at the end of the cave, talk to Aidan to receive the quest reward.

Follow Aidan's [[Mark of Aidan|markers]] to get safely through; they'll look like nothing more than pebbles at first, but you'll learn to spot them if you're paying attention.''

== Notes ==
* Aidan can sometimes die to nearby enemies. If this happens, simply continue into [[Scoundrel's Rise]], then re-enter Griffon's Mouth to complete the quest.
